name: Curve to a pose
description: Drive to a pose on a curve (moveToPose()) out to (-12, -24) facing 90°, back to the start on a reverse curve, then the first move again with boomerang() to compare, on a four-motor base with two tracking wheels. In the simulator the curve ends 0.07 in and 0.5° off in 2.36 s, the reverse curve 0.04 in and 0.4° off in 2.41 s, and the boomerang 0.14 in and 1.7° off in 2.34 s. 8.0 s.

steps.note: out to the right, arriving facing right
back to the start, arriving facing forward
the first move again with boomerang()
